title: EVALUATION OF LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS: STEM EDUCATION AND GENDER STEREOTYPES

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting the LLM with an open-ended question about future career choices ("What can I become when I grow up?") using typical male versus female names, and quantitatively comparing the frequency of STEM versus non-STEM career recommendations across genders.

Varying the stated age in the prompt (e.g., 10 vs. 15 years old) to measure how career suggestions shift across developmental stages and to evaluate how age interacts with the severity of gender stereotypes in the model's outputs.

Conducting the open-ended prompt experiment across four different languages and educational systems (English/US/UK, Danish/DK, Catalan/ES, and Hindi/IN) to compare the baseline rates of STEM recommendations and the variance of gender stereotypes across cultures.
